title: ctrl-ai model catalogue (config/models.yaml)
description: The organisation's list of models and their governance. The gateway enforces it; the admin panel edits it.

unmanaged_channels.description: AI channels no gateway can route, stated as policy with their control.

id.description: The model name clients send, as in deploy/litellm/config.yaml model_list (model_name). A trailing * is a prefix match, e.g. claude-*.

sunset.description: For deprecated models: after this date requests are rerouted to equivalent.

teams.description: Team ids, or ["*"] for every team.

shadow.description: True for free-tier use: the price is the list price, not what the organisation pays.

equivalent.description: Model id to reroute to when this one is not allowed.

fallbacks.description: Ordered model ids to try when this model's provider fails.
